canonical_name: Four Color Theorem for finite planar simple graphs or simple planar maps
literal_source_claim_zh: 平面图可用四种颜色着色
literal_source_claim_en: Planar graphs can be colored with four colors.
canonical_statement: Provisional theorem-family scope: every finite planar simple graph, or equivalently the region-adjacency graph of a simple planar map under a checked representation bridge, admits a proper coloring using at most four colors. The exact planarity, finiteness, graph/map, adjacency, and degenerate-case conventions remain to be source-frozen.
canonical_claim: Every source-approved finite planar simple graph or simple planar map admits a proper coloring with at most four colors, after every representation bridge is checked.
statement_blocker: The catalog does not define planar graph, finite carrier, simple graph/map, graph versus region coloring, graph-map equivalence, embedding model, region adjacency, loops or parallel edges, disconnected and empty cases, or whether a topological, combinatorial-map, hypermap, excluded-minor, or other planarity encoding is canonical. Selecting one Lean proposition at intake would silently resolve material scope and transport choices.

canonical_formal_target.candidate_expression: forall (V : Type u) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V), Planar G -> G.Colorable 4

domain_and_universes: Open: an approved source must fix a finite graph or planar-map carrier, the plane/real model or combinatorial embedding carrier, all universe levels, graph simplicity and finiteness structures, and any decidability or topology instances.
conclusion: Open formal target: existence of a source-faithful proper coloring with at most four colors for every object satisfying the exact source-selected finite-planar premise.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded at intake because no exact representation is selected; the statement phase must resolve every empty, disconnected, bridge, loop, parallel-edge, isolated-vertex, low-cardinality, region-boundary, and embedding case listed in scope-map.md.
